visual.description: Left column contains label, headline, body text, and CTA button; right column contains a video thumbnail with play button, both sitting on a light beige background with decorative organic shapes bleeding off the right edge.
Full-width horizontal tab bar with 6 labeled sections (Products, Get insights, Built on trust, Industry solutions, News and insights, Customer stories, FAQ) that sticks below the main navigation.

Centered headline and body text above a horizontal row of 4 equal-width product cards, each containing an image, category label, bold title, and a CTA link; cards overflow the viewport hinting at horizontal scroll.
Left column holds a numbered list of resources plus two CTA buttons; right column shows a grid of 4 document cover images arranged in a 2x2 pattern inside a rounded card.
Full-width section with large centered headline, supporting body text, and a single solid purple CTA button, sitting on a plain light background.
Three equal-width semi-transparent card columns float over a full-bleed atmospheric image, each card containing an icon, bold title, description text, and a Learn more link.
Three equal-width white cards each show a top image, category heading, title, description, and a Learn more link; pagination arrows sit below indicating a carousel with more cards off-screen.
Three equal-width white cards display editorial images at the top, bold article titles, and icon+label CTA links at the bottom; left/right arrows indicate a carousel.

A large horizontal featured story card with text on the left and a building photo on the right sits above a full-width horizontal strip of 6 equal-width logo tiles (Poloplast, LC Waikiki, Microsoft, PwC, G-Star, MTR).

Full-width accordion list with numbered entries (01/–10/) separated by horizontal rules; each row has a red sequence number on the left, question text in the center, and a purple toggle button on the right.
Two side-by-side rounded cards each contain an icon, headline, body text, CTA links, and a right-side lifestyle or product image embedded within the card boundary.

Social follow row at top, then a 6-column link grid (What's new, Microsoft Store, Education, Business, Developer & IT, Company), followed by a legal/utility bar with locale selector, privacy toggles, and sitemap links.
